question: If the difference between the interior and exterior angles of a regular polygon is 100°, find the number of sides of the polygon.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of interior and exterior angles of any regular polygon is always 180°.

Exterior angle = (180° − 100°) ÷ 2 = 40°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 40° = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**
